title: Wyoming Police Departments Testing AI To Generate Reports, Look At Evidence
description: Wyoming police are testing artificial intelligence to write reports and analyze evidence, but the rules of how that happens haven’t caught up. A former Wyoming attorney general has mixed reactions on it and said her concern is AI's ability to "hallucinate."

title: AI agents shift K-12 procurement from product demos to workflow outcomes
description: AI agents are entering K-12 purchasing workflows, forcing districts to shift procurement criteria from demo features to measurable outcomes like time saved and error rates.
